preheader: Oil prices spike above $100, BofA warns of bond competition, and a UCI study tracks ChatGPT's brain impact.

lead.headline: Oil Spikes Above $100 on Middle East Attacks and Gulf Storm Threat
lead.body: Brent crude oil prices jumped back above $101 per barrel on Wednesday, while West Texas Intermediate neared $90. The sudden price surge comes amid rising attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and a looming storm threatening the US Gulf Coast.
lead.why: Energy prices directly impact inflation and corporate profit margins. As a business student, watch how these spikes affect retail and transport stocks in your mock or real portfolios.

figures.label: West Texas Intermediate price per barrel

stories.headline: Bank of America Warns That Bonds Are Now Actively Competing With Stocks
stories.body: Savita Subramanian at Bank of America cautioned that equity markets face a genuine rival in bonds for the first time in decades. High investor sentiment also leaves stocks more vulnerable to disappointment.
stories.why: When bond yields are high, investors often pull money out of risky stocks and put it into safer bonds. This shift can cool down stock market rallies and change how you should allocate your personal investments.

stories.headline: Quick-Commerce Startup Eternal Overtakes Tech Giant TCS in Index Weight
stories.body: Consumer internet startup Eternal has surpassed Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in weightage on India's benchmark Nifty 50 index. This shift highlights the rising influence of fast-growing consumer tech companies over traditional IT services.
stories.why: This is a classic example of market disruption. It shows how rapidly agile startups can scale and displace legacy giants, a key concept for your corporate strategy classes.

stories.headline: Former OpenAI and Anthropic Researcher Warns of AI Automation Risks
stories.body: Jacob Coxon, a 27-year-old researcher, warned New York City lawmakers that advanced AI research could soon outpace human oversight. He expressed concern that safety measures are failing to keep up with rapid capability gains.
stories.why: As you look into tech consulting or startups, understanding the regulatory and safety debates around AI will help you navigate future compliance and ethical challenges.

stories.headline: Anthropic Expands Claude Startups Program to Support Early-Stage Founders
stories.body: AI company Anthropic is expanding its "Claude Startups" program to offer early-stage founders up to $7,000 in product credits. It also includes up to $45,000 in benefits for partner tools to help AI-native businesses scale.
stories.why: If you plan to launch a startup at UCI, programs like this can drastically lower your initial software and infrastructure costs.

stories.headline: AI Reshapes Entry-Level Roles, Pushing Gen-Z Into Strategic Work Sooner
stories.body: Artificial intelligence is taking over routine administrative tasks traditionally assigned to junior staff in Britain. This shift is expected to push young professionals into strategic, commercial, and relationship-based work much earlier in their careers.
stories.why: This means your first internship or job won't just be about spreadsheets and data entry. You will need to develop soft skills and strategic thinking early to stand out.

stories.headline: Deloitte India CEO Bets AI Will Drive Massive Hiring Surge
stories.body: Romal Shetty believes AI will generate so much new client work that Deloitte will need to hire thousands of additional employees. The firm plans to use AI to reach entirely new customer segments that were previously inaccessible.
stories.why: If you are aiming for a consulting career, this shows that AI is not just a threat to jobs, but a massive driver of new consulting services and hiring.

stories.headline: UCI Study Finds Passive Chatbot Use Can Blunt Critical Thinking
stories.body: Researchers at UC Irvine partnered with McGraw Hill to analyze 10 years of student usage data from the learning platform Aleks. They found that passive reliance on chatbots can weaken critical thinking skills unless students actively change how they interact with the tools.

stories.headline: Coco Gauff Exits China Open After Loss to Elise Mertens
stories.body: World number four Coco Gauff lost 6-3, 6-3 to Belgium's Elise Mertens in the fourth round of the China Open, ending Gauff's five-match winning streak against her. Gauff noted that online racist abuse during the tournament had left her feeling exhausted and drained.

term.name: Chapter 11 Bankruptcy
term.definition: A legal process that allows a business to restructure its debts and operations while continuing to run. Unlike liquidation, the company stays alive and tries to find a path back to profitability. Today, health-focused restaurant chain True Food Kitchen filed for Chapter 11 protection after closing 12 locations.

serve.headline: Siena raised $17M to build AI agents for consumer brands
serve.body: New York-based startup Siena secured a $17 million Series A round led by York IE, bringing its total funding to $29.7 million. The company designs AI-powered customer service agents tailored for consumer brands.
